Use case: logo-brand, Chinese calligraphy glyph for an existing educational website.
Asset type: single transparent PNG calligraphy character, matching the supplied reference from the website's Structure panel.
Primary request: Write exactly the SINGLE simplified Chinese character "喜", and absolutely no other characters. Replace the reference character 神 with "喜" while matching its rich cinnabar red ink palette, forceful traditional Chinese brush calligraphy, expressive thick and thin strokes, dry-brush feibai streaks, natural pigment grain, sharp energetic stroke endings and subtle red ink density variation.
Composition: one complete legible character centered in a square canvas, approximately 80% of the canvas, with sufficient clear padding on all four sides so no brushstroke or terminal touches or clips a canvas edge. Keep a coherent, confident semi-cursive Chinese brush style; retain correct identifiable stroke structure of "喜". This is one member of a unified eight-character set 喜 怒 哀 乐 动 静 惊 疑.
Text (verbatim): "喜". Use simplified Chinese exactly. The reference is STYLE only, do not copy 神.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside the ink, including open counters and brush gaps. The website supplies its own warm paper background.
Constraints: NO paper, beige or white background, checkerboard pattern, frame, stamp, signature, caption, extra symbols, ornamental flourishes detached from the written character, shadow, glow, gradients or rendered physical objects. Do not set this as a typeset font. Deliver only the newly hand-brushed red "喜" as an isolated transparent bitmap.
